name: DataTable
example:
With Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(1).Chart
 .HasDataTable = True
 .DataTable.HasBorderOutline = True
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: ShowLegendKey
properties.description: True if the data label legend key is visible. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasBorderHorizontal
properties.description: True if the chart data table has horizontal cell borders. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasBorderVertical
properties.description: True if the chart data table has vertical cell borders. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasBorderOutline
properties.description: True if the chart data table has outline borders. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Border
properties.description: Returns a Border object that represents the border of the object.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns a Font object that represents the font of the specified object.
